plainText:
Kotono Mitsuishi (Japanese: 三石琴乃 Mitsuishi Kotono) is a Japanese voice actress for and .

==Biography==
Mitsuishi was born on December 8, 1967, in , , and she became a voice actress as an adult. She first started her work in . Her first role was that of Duplica's Ditto, and she later provided the voice of all that appeared in the show. Her most major human role was that of Domino in Mewtwo Returns.
